::: {#rem-vanishing-remedies}

#### What keeps gradients from vanishing

The [ReLU](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-relu), whose slope is 1 wherever a unit is positive, is one remedy.
The rest of these notes take up the others:
starting the weights at a scale that keeps the gradient's size steady from layer to layer,
normalizing each layer's values,
and residual connections, which give the gradient a path around each layer.
[lds's experiment on depth](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/backpropagation.html#sec-vanishing-experiment) measures the same effect.

:::
